column3: “Serve the LORD” retains the service verb rendered “worship the LORD.”
Does not explicitly add “otherwise” to the Egyptians’ explanation.
Names “the little ones,” without a separate noun “women.”
“A night of vigils for the LORD” does not explicitly make the LORD the subject of keeping a vigil.
Names money as the means of purchase, rather than simply saying the slave was purchased.
Retains the singular “a bone,” rather than “any of the bones.”
Does not explicitly insert “wants” before the foreigner’s observance of the Passover.
